statements.markdown: **Theorem 6.1 (Infinitely many greedy skips force membership).** *Fix $x\ge0$. If $r_n(x)>R_n$ at some rank $n$, every later rank is selected and $r_{n+k}(x)>R_{n+k}$ for every $k\ge0$. Consequently, infinitely many omitted positive ranks imply $x\in\mathcal A$.*
